name: pt-social-contributions
description: Portuguese social security contributions (Segurança Social) for tax year 2026 under the Código dos Regimes Contributivos (Lei 110/2009). Covers self-employed workers (trabalhadores independentes): 21.4% (25.2% for empresários em nome individual and EIRL holders), relevant income at 70% of services and 20% of goods, the quarterly declaration and the monthly payment from the 10th to the 20th, the EUR 20 minimum, the first-12-months rule, the 4 x IAS exemption with employment and the 12 x IAS ceiling on the 2026 IAS of EUR 537.13, organised accounts, the 25% option, and contracting entities (10% or 7%). Also the headline employee and employer rates (11% and 23.75%), special rates, members of corporate bodies (MOE), employer deadlines, fines and late interest. Trigger on: 'Segurança Social independente', 'declaração trimestral', 'recibos verdes contribuições', 'entidade contratante', 'MOE gerente', 'TSU'. Out of scope: payroll computation (portugal-payroll), IRS (pt-income-tax), cross-bord
